## Before downloading

1. Request access from the Telehealth Network of Minas Gerais.
2. Download all files into one folder, keeping the provider's folder structure.

## Get the data

Download the files into a folder as the steps above say, then import the folder:

```bash
biosignal-data import code/code-ii <folder you downloaded into> --version <label> --dest s3://<bucket>
```
